name: The Bet
overview: Fate, in the form of certain life circumstances, brings two young people, just over thirty, together in space and time. After an introduction that began with a scandal and escalated into a fight, a philosophical conversation naturally ensued. The conversation happily devolved into an argument about "who's cooler" and "who are you in life?" The essence of the argument is, in fact, as old as time itself and is a variation on the theme: "What came first: the chicken or the egg?" In our version: "What's more important: business or creativity?"
